title: Covariant Approximate Quantum Codes for Protected Analog Computation
summary: Quantum error correction compatible with continuous symmetries is a fundamental problem in quantum information and a possible route to robust analog quantum simulation. Because the Eastin-Knill theorem forbids exact codes with continuous transversal symmetries, we construct explicit $SU(d)$-covariant approximate codes that exploit permutation symmetry to spread logical information uniformly across all physical subsystems.
